observed_facts: Six saved tracebacks identify PMLParameters.__post_init__ F0 range validation, after analyze returned, not the native decoder.
All six saved post F0 arrays contain strictly positive but <=50 Hz values, 20 frames total; none reaches 700 Hz.
All L/F positive raw F0 values are >50 and <700 Hz; raw zeros exactly match gate=0 and q_index=-1.
All strict post violations occur on gate=1. Raw gate=0 entries become positive post values. No exact-zero window exists; z_valid is true for every frame.
All L/F raw/submitted/selector F0 values and grids match bitwise; L/F post grids match raw grids bitwise, with resampled=false.
Saved diagnostics report clip-to-65..700 before step removal and report later outside-65..700 frames; all_unvoiced_fallback is false.
Baseline PML succeeds on the same three records; its raw grid is REAPER-derived/non-bit-exact 5ms, and existing postprocess resamples it.

source_based_mechanism.classification: source-supported mechanism inference, not a replay or a newly measured filter response

steps.meaning: Selector emits zero at gate=0 and saved grid candidate frequency at gate=1.
The raw positive contour is interpolated across unvoiced rows, then clipped to inclusive [65,700].

After clipping, step removal interpolates to an intermediate grid, applies 8th-order Butterworth low-pass with scipy.signal.filtfilt, then interpolates back. A smoothing filter need not preserve pointwise extrema; undershoot below 65 is consistent with these saved post values.
No second clip is present; L/F resampled=false. The postprocess final gate checks finite and >0 only, so positive <=50 values pass.
StoneMask is used only for CheapTrick. PDD and synthesis retain postprocessed F0, not refined_ct_f0.
After analyze returns, trace is updated and PMLParameters receives features[f0s][:,1], namely saved post_f0, not refined_ct_f0.
Constructor rejects any nonfinite, <=50 or >=700 F0, producing exactly the saved error.
Parameter construction fails before payload save/load/native decode, while finally persists the raw/post/refined trace.

source_based_mechanism.limits: A pre-smoothing clipped array is not retained. This diagnosis does not claim to reproduce filter coefficients/output or estimate a repair. The raw positive lower candidate 50.78125 Hz is valid raw input but the later postprocess may undershoot the stricter synthesis boundary.
